get.description: Upgrades to a WebSocket. Send `{"t":"hello","caseId":"...","lastSeq":null}` to join a case, then receive a snapshot and every later operation. The messages are defined by `ClientMessageSchema` and `ServerMessage` in `packages/core/src/sync/protocol.ts`. Read tokens may watch, and any operation they send is rejected.

post.description: Speaks JSON-RPC over the stateless form of the Streamable HTTP transport, and takes an API token only, never a session. See the MCP guide.

post.description: The way to change a case. Send a `clientOpId` so a retry cannot apply twice. Send `baseSeq`, the seq you last saw, to hear in `overwrote` which fields someone else changed since.
Appends a new operation that reverses the old one. Nothing is erased.
Takes nmap XML or normal output. Parsing happens in the background: the scan starts as `parsing`, so poll the list or watch the WebSocket until it is `ready` or `failed`.
